visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shows raw, marbled beef slices arranged in a circle on a grill. A person wearing black latex gloves uses metal tongs to flip a piece of meat. Two women sit in the background under warm restaurant lighting. (2) A man in a denim jacket and grey cap sits at a table laden with plates of sliced beef. He gestures with his hands while talking to the women. (3) The three diners exhibit surprised and impressed facial expressions, looking at something off-camera with wide eyes. (4) The man uses chopsticks to put a piece of meat into his mouth. Various yellow text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame. (5) A close-up highlights a seaweed hand roll topped with a generous amount of bright orange shrimp roe. (6) The man hands the hand rolls to his companions, and they all take bites simultaneously, smiling. (7) The scene shifts to a bright, modern shop. The man, now in a grey jumpsuit, holds a food bowl and a plastic cup with a drink, pointing to his smartphone screen. (8) Two women stand near a wooden counter; one holds a wooden tray with a bowl and drink. They look at each other while having a conversation. (9) The man stands before a wall featuring a circular logo, holding a phone in one hand and a paper brochure in the other. (10) A quick montage shows a phone scanning a QR code at a counter, close-ups of grilled meat, and the exterior of a restaurant with a wooden sign. (11) A screen recording shows a mobile app interface with Chinese text and icons related to health services and reservations. (12) The man talks to a female staff member at the counter, holding his phone up to show the screen. (13) Chocolate sauce on white plates is used to create art depicting the man's caricature and a mascot logo for an app.

(2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. The music continues its steady, energetic beat at approximately 128 BPM. The male speaker's delivery is rapid and engaging, emphasizing specific words with pitch modulation. (3) A shimmering sound effect accompanies the visual of a shrimp roe hand roll. The male voice exhibits a rising intonation, sounding excited and persuasive about the dining benefits. (4) A digital 'ding' sound effect occurs as text overlays appear. The male voice continues narration, now in a more instructional tone explaining app rewards. A brief snippet of female dialogue is heard, exhibiting casual conversational textures. (5) The BGM swells slightly in the mix as the male voice explains the vaccine reservation feature. A 'beep' SFX simulating a scanner is heard. The vocal delivery is clear and professionally enunciated. (6) A short sequence of conversational dialogue between the male and a female occurs. The female voice has a higher pitch and a questioning inflection. The BGM tempo remains unchanged. (7) The audio concludes with a final melodic stinger and a soft chime, while the music fades out quickly over the last two seconds.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Evidence (Food) -> Evidence (Services) -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a strategic promotion for the 'Taichung Pass' (台中通 TCPASS) app. It uses the persona of a proud Taichung native to demonstrate the tangible benefits of the app, such as restaurant discounts and public service features like vaccine booking, to encourage downloads.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation to download the app, display of its features, and showing the logo and QR code.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high production value editing and popular food choices to grab attention before pivoting to utility-based app features.
